claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms field and project description
PRIDE keywords 'Macrophages' and title (human macrophages); CL:0000235
PRIDE project description: control 114, LPS 115, Curdlan 116, GBY 117
Protocol text: QSTAR Elite hybrid quadrupole TOF (PRIDE field says only QSTAR); wiff headers show QSTAR acquisition
Protocol text: cysteine alkylation with MMTS (ProteinPilot search criteria); UNIMOD:39 verified in OLS
Protocol text: MS data acquired automatically with Analyst QS 2.0, IDA/data-dependent method in wiff headers

Two iTRAQ sets (group files 090525LauraiTRAQ1all and 090616LauraiTRAQ2all, 'two biological replicates' in protocol). Assignment of RAW files to sets is INFERRED from acquisition date (files before 2009-05-25 = set 1, from 2009-06-05 = set 2)
Protocol: each SCX fraction analyzed twice. Repeat order by acquisition date in file name; 090429Laura120minB11b is a third injection of set 1 fraction B11
Order A14,A15,B1..B15,C1..C7 assumed to be SCX elution order; patched into built SDRF

limitations: Paper full text not available (no PMC); only PRIDE text and the abstract were used, so no paper-derived claims are made.

RAW file to iTRAQ set (biological replicate) assignment is inferred from acquisition dates versus the dates in the two deposited .group file names; the .group files (proprietary ProteinPilot binary, ~0.8-0.9 GB) could not be decoded. Set assignment and technical-replicate order are therefore uncertain.

Fraction identifiers follow the letter/number code in file names (A14..C7 -> 1..24, assumed elution order, patched post-build with a scripted row rewrite); the SCX fraction ordering and the 120min-gradient reruns are assumed.
Each wiff is a 4-plex iTRAQ injection; one row per channel per file (83 wiff x 4 = 332 rows). The 83 .wiff.scan companion files are not listed as data files (sidecars of the .wiff).

Cell donor, age, sex, disease, organism part, macrophage differentiation protocol, reduction reagent, tolerances and dissociation are not stated in the PRIDE record: not available. 'GBY' is not expanded in the record. Treatment values LPS, curdlan, GBY are free text (not matched in NCIT/EFO).

iTRAQ 4plex labelling modification and 'biological modifications' of the ProteinPilot search are not listed as modification parameters (search output undecodable); only MMTS carbamidomethyl-equivalent fixed Methylthio on Cys is declared.
Two sets treated as separate sources (e.g. control_set1, control_set2) because donors/independence are not documented.

iTRAQ4plex (UNIMOD:214) added as fixed modification on Lys after review (labelling stated in PRIDE description); peptide N-term labelling not encoded. SANDBOX ONLY (independent review FAIL): iTRAQ set assignment (by file date), technical-replicate order and fraction numbering are inferred because the .group files could not be decoded.
